segments.en: Hello everyone and welcome to EnglishPod.
segments.zh: 大家好，欢迎来到 EnglishPod。

segments.en: My name is Marco.
segments.zh: 我叫 Marco。

segments.en: My name is Catherine and today we've got an elementary level lesson for you all about getting up in the morning.
segments.zh: 我的名字是凯瑟琳，今天我们为大家准备了一节关于早上起床的初级课程。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Today we're making breakfast and well, of course, many people have different things when they're making breakfast.
segments.zh: 今天我们正在做早餐，当然，很多人在做早餐时都有不同的东西。

segments.en: Some of them are very big, others are small.
segments.zh: 其中一些非常大，其他的很小。

segments.en: So but this is what we're going to talk about today.
segments.zh: 不过这就是我们今天要讨论的内容。

segments.en: So why don't we listen to the dialogue and see what they're having for breakfast today.
segments.zh: 那么我们为什么不听对话，看看他们今天早餐吃什么。

segments.en: Smells good.
segments.zh: 闻起来真香。

segments.en: What's for breakfast?
segments.zh: 早餐吃什么？

segments.en: Well, since we're getting up so late, I decided to make a big breakfast.
segments.zh: 好吧，既然我们起得这么晚，我决定做一顿丰盛的早餐。

segments.en: Nice.
segments.zh: 不错。

segments.en: Brunch.
segments.zh: 早午餐。

segments.en: Kind of.
segments.zh: 有点儿。

segments.en: So I made scrambled and soft boiled eggs, some French toast and buttermilk pancakes.
segments.zh: 我做了炒蛋、溏心煮蛋、法式吐司，还有酪乳煎饼。

segments.en: Wow, you really went all out.
segments.zh: 哇，你真的全力以赴。

segments.en: Did you make any coffee?
segments.zh: 你煮咖啡了吗？

segments.en: Yeah, just the way you like it.
segments.zh: 是的，就是你喜欢的方式。

segments.en: I also put out some cereal and muesli if you feel like having something more light.
segments.zh: 如果想吃得清淡点，我还准备了早餐谷物和混合果仁燕麦片。

segments.en: Looks good.
segments.zh: 看起来不错。

segments.en: I'll squeeze us some fresh orange juice.
segments.zh: 我会给我们挤一些新鲜的橙汁。

segments.en: Get the jam and butter while you are in there.
segments.zh: 你去那边时，顺便把果酱和黄油拿过来。

segments.en: Oh, and don't forget the syrup.
segments.zh: 哦，别忘了糖浆。

segments.en: All righty.
segments.zh: 好嘞。

segments.en: All right, we're back.
segments.zh: 好了，我们回来了。

segments.en: So a lot of interesting things.
segments.zh: 所以很多有趣的事情。

segments.en: A huge breakfast.
segments.zh: 丰盛的早餐。

segments.en: Way too big for me.
segments.zh: 对我来说太大了。

segments.en: I don't like to eat a big breakfast because I feel like it makes me tired and then I don't have any energy.
segments.zh: 我不喜欢吃一顿丰盛的早餐，因为我觉得它让我很累，然后我没有任何精力。

segments.en: Especially if you just get up, right?
segments.zh: 特别是如果你刚起床，对吧？

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: You need to shower and maybe have some fruit and then go to work.
segments.zh: 你需要冲个澡，也许吃点水果，然后去上班。

segments.en: But we can talk about that at the end.
segments.zh: 但我们可以在最后讨论这个问题。

segments.en: There were a lot of interesting words and phrases that we heard that we would benefit from taking a closer look at.
segments.zh: 我们听到的很多有趣的单词和短语，值得我们仔细看一看。

segments.en: Language takeaway.
segments.zh: 语言要点。

segments.en: All right, so on Language Takeaway today, we're going to take a look at our first word and it's an interesting word.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以今天的语言要点，我们将看看我们的第一个单词，这是一个有趣的词。

segments.en: It's kind of a mix of two things.
segments.zh: 这是两种东西的混合。

segments.en: Brunch.
segments.zh: 早午餐。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So this word comes from two different words.
segments.zh: 所以这个词来自两个不同的词。

segments.en: Breakfast, b-b-breakfast and lunch.
segments.zh: 早餐，B-B-早餐和午餐。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So brunch.
segments.zh: 所以早午餐。

segments.en: So if you have brunch, what is exactly brunch?
segments.zh: 那如果你吃早午餐，早午餐到底是什么？

segments.en: Well there's two ways to look at brunch.
segments.zh: 好吧，可以从两个角度来看早午餐。

segments.en: One is the time element.
segments.zh: 一是时间元素。

segments.en: Usually brunch is later than breakfast, but maybe a little earlier than lunch.
segments.zh: 通常早午餐比早餐晚，但可能比午餐早一点。

segments.en: So 11 o'clock or maybe even noon.
segments.zh: 所以 11 点甚至中午。

segments.en: But the other thing is size.
segments.zh: 但另一件事是大小。

segments.en: Because you're putting two meals together, usually brunch is very big.
segments.zh: 因为你把两顿饭放在一起，通常早午餐是非常大的。

segments.en: You eat a lot of food.
segments.zh: 你吃很多食物。

segments.en: Okay, so it's a perfect combination of breakfast and lunch.
segments.zh: 好的，所以它是早餐和午餐的完美结合。

segments.en: I'm the type of person that likes having scrambled eggs at noon.
segments.zh: 我是那种喜欢中午吃炒鸡蛋的人。

segments.en: So this is a perfect solution, brunch.
segments.zh: 所以这是一个完美的解决方案，早午餐。

segments.en: Right, you don't have to only eat eggs at breakfast, you can eat them at lunch as well.
segments.zh: 对了，你不必只在早餐吃鸡蛋，午餐也可以吃。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: This is actually something we do a lot in America for Mother's Day.
segments.zh: 实际上在美国，母亲节我们经常这么做。

segments.en: So mom wakes up late, we take her to brunch.
segments.zh: 所以妈妈起晚了，我们带她去吃早午餐。

segments.en: It's a very big special meal.
segments.zh: 这是一顿非常丰盛的特殊大餐。

segments.en: Very good.
segments.zh: 很好。

segments.en: And talking about eggs and the types of eggs that we can have, I mentioned scrambled eggs and in the dialogue we also heard soft-boiled eggs.
segments.zh: 说到鸡蛋和能吃的各种鸡蛋做法，我提到了炒蛋，对话里我们还听到 soft-boiled eggs，也就是溏心蛋。

segments.en: Okay, these are two very important kinds of eggs.
segments.zh: 好吧，这是两种非常重要的鸡蛋。

segments.en: Usually if you're in a restaurant, they will ask you how do you want your eggs cooked or done.
segments.zh: 通常，如果您在餐厅，他们会问您如何煮或煮鸡蛋。

segments.en: And my answer is always scrambled.
segments.zh: 我的回答总是炒蛋。

segments.en: This means someone mixes the eggs before they are cooked and then when they cook, they are hard, they're yellow.
segments.zh: 这是指有人在下锅前把鸡蛋打散，煮好后就结成块，是黄色的。

segments.en: There's no white, it's just yellow and it's a little hard mixture.
segments.zh: 没有白色，只是黄色，有点硬的混合物。

segments.en: But soft-boiled eggs are very, very different.
segments.zh: 但软煮鸡蛋非常非常不同。

segments.en: That's right, soft-boiled eggs, you actually don't break the egg or open the egg to cook it like in scrambled eggs.
segments.zh: 没错，软煮鸡蛋，你实际上不会像炒鸡蛋一样打碎鸡蛋或打开鸡蛋。

segments.en: You actually put the entire egg in boiling water.
segments.zh: 你实际上把整个鸡蛋放在沸水中。

segments.en: I think it's for two minutes and then you take it out and then you open the shell and the eggs are kind of cooked, it's kind of hard in some parts but it's also kind of liquidy in other parts.
segments.zh: 我想是两分钟，然后你把它拿出来，然后你打开外壳，鸡蛋有点煮熟，在某些地方有点硬，但在其他地方也有点流动。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So the outside, the white part is hard but the yellow part, the yolk is liquid.
segments.zh: 所以外面，白色的部分是硬的，黄色的部分，蛋黄是液体的。

segments.en: It's not hard.
segments.zh: 它不是硬的。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: And actually if you want the whole egg to be hard, you can ask for hard-boiled eggs.
segments.zh: 实际上，如果你想让整个鸡蛋都熟透变硬，可以点全熟蛋。

segments.en: That's right, those are cooked for much longer.
segments.zh: 没错，这些煮的时间更长。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Okay, so we have scrambled eggs, soft-boiled eggs, we have French toast and we have buttermilk pancakes.
segments.zh: 好的，所以我们有炒鸡蛋，软煮鸡蛋，我们有法式吐司，我们有酪乳煎饼。

segments.en: Okay, so you can ask for just pancakes.
segments.zh: 好的，所以你可以只要求煎饼。

segments.en: But if you want to be specific, you want to give instructions about what kind of pancakes, you can ask for buttermilk pancakes.
segments.zh: 但如果你想说得更具体，说明要哪种煎饼，就可以点酪乳煎饼。

segments.en: And what exactly is buttermilk?
segments.zh: 究竟什么是酪乳？

segments.en: Buttermilk is a very, very creamy, eggy milk that's very, very high in fat that makes everything taste better, I think.
segments.zh: 酪乳是一种非常浓郁、带蛋香的奶，脂肪含量非常非常高，我觉得它能让什么东西都变得更好吃。

segments.en: This is used a lot in baking, not really in other kinds of foods.
segments.zh: 这在烘焙中经常使用，而不是在其他类型的食物中。

segments.en: So you can have buttermilk muffins or buttermilk biscuits.
segments.zh: 所以你可以吃酪乳松饼或酪乳饼干。

segments.en: But usually you have buttermilk pancakes and so these are very rich, very fatty pancakes.
segments.zh: 但通常你会吃酪乳煎饼，这种煎饼口感很浓郁，油分很足。

segments.en: Awesome, yeah, they taste delicious.
segments.zh: 太棒了，是的，它们味道鲜美。

segments.en: Alright, so now if we want to eat a little bit more healthy, we do have some cereal and some muesli.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以如果想吃得健康一点，我们确实有一些谷物麦片和一些什锦麦片。

segments.en: Muesli is a funny word, it's not a sound we make very often in English.
segments.zh: Muesli 是个有趣的词，英语里我们不太常发这个音。

segments.en: Muesli.
segments.zh: Muesli，什锦麦片。

segments.en: Yeah.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: I think it actually comes from German.
segments.zh: 我认为它实际上来自德语。

segments.en: It does look German.
segments.zh: 它看起来确实像德语。

segments.en: Because actually the spelling is M-U-E, so you would kind of want to say Muesli or something.
segments.zh: 因为拼写其实是 M-U-E，所以你会想读成 Muesli 之类的。

segments.en: Yeah, no, we say Muesli and it's basically a mixture of granola or different kinds of fiber grains.
segments.zh: 对，不，我们读 Muesli，它基本上是格兰诺拉麦片或不同种类的纤维谷物的混合物。

segments.en: So just think of having raisins and maybe some almonds, granola, all mixed up and you have this nice thing that goes well with yogurt, muesli.
segments.zh: 所以想象一下葡萄干，也许还有一些杏仁、格兰诺拉麦片，全都混在一起，配上酸奶很合适，这就是 muesli。

segments.en: It's very, very tasty and also very good for you.
segments.zh: 它非常非常好吃，对你也很好。

segments.en: And now, well, actually going back to pancakes, no pancake is possible to eat unless you put syrup on it, right?
segments.zh: 现在，好吧，实际上回到煎饼，除非你在上面放糖浆，否则不可能吃煎饼，对吧？

segments.en: Well, some people might disagree.
segments.zh: 好吧，有些人可能不同意。

segments.en: I know a lot of people who eat pancakes with honey or with butter.
segments.zh: 我认识很多人吃蜂蜜或黄油煎饼。

segments.en: But the best, I think, is with syrup.
segments.zh: 但我认为最好的是糖浆。

segments.en: And syrup is basically liquid sugar and you put it on your pancakes to make them sweeter.
segments.zh: 糖浆基本上是液体糖，你把它放在煎饼上，让它们更甜。

segments.en: Actually, it's the same thing as honey basically, except that it doesn't come from bees.
segments.zh: 实际上，它基本上和蜂蜜是一样的，只是它不是来自蜜蜂。

segments.en: Right, so real syrup, we say maple syrup, comes from maple trees and you tap the tree and it comes out.
segments.zh: 对，所以真正的糖浆，我们叫枫糖浆，来自枫树，在树上打孔，汁液就流出来了。

segments.en: It's very, very, very sweet.
segments.zh: 它非常非常非常甜蜜。

segments.en: But we also have syrup you can buy at the store, which is man-made.
segments.zh: 但我们也有你可以在商店购买的糖浆，这是人造的。

segments.en: Artificial.
segments.zh: 人造。

segments.en: Yeah, it's basically just sugar.
segments.zh: 是的，基本上只是糖。

segments.en: Okay, very good.
segments.zh: 好，很好。

segments.en: So that's what we have with pancakes usually.
segments.zh: 这就是我们吃煎饼时通常搭配的东西。

segments.en: But why don't we go back, listen to our dialogue again.
segments.zh: 但是我们为什么不回去，再听一次我们的对话。

segments.en: Let's review all of these yummy breakfast treats and we'll come back in a bit with Fluency Builder.
segments.zh: 让我们回顾一下这些美味的早餐，稍后我们会带着流利表达回来。

segments.en: Smells good.
segments.zh: 闻起来真香。

segments.en: What's for breakfast?
segments.zh: 早餐吃什么？

segments.en: Well, since we're getting up so late, I decided to make a big breakfast.
segments.zh: 好吧，既然我们起得这么晚，我决定做一顿丰盛的早餐。

segments.en: Nice, brunch.
segments.zh: 不错，早午餐。

segments.en: Kind of.
segments.zh: 有点儿。

segments.en: So I made scrambled and soft-boiled eggs, some French toast, and buttermilk pancakes.
segments.zh: 所以我做了炒蛋和溏心蛋、一些法式吐司，还有酪乳煎饼。

segments.en: Wow, you really went all out.
segments.zh: 哇，你真的全力以赴。

segments.en: Did you make any coffee?
segments.zh: 你煮咖啡了吗？

segments.en: Yeah, just the way you like it.
segments.zh: 是的，就是你喜欢的方式。

segments.en: I also put out some cereal and muesli if you feel like having something more light.
segments.zh: 如果想吃得清淡点，我还准备了早餐谷物和混合果仁燕麦片。

segments.en: Looks good.
segments.zh: 看起来不错。

segments.en: I'll squeeze us some fresh orange juice.
segments.zh: 我会给我们挤一些新鲜的橙汁。

segments.en: Get the jam and butter while you are in there.
segments.zh: 你去那边时，顺便把果酱和黄油拿过来。

segments.en: Oh, and don't forget the syrup.
segments.zh: 哦，别忘了糖浆。

segments.en: Alrighty.
segments.zh: 好吧。

segments.en: All right, so now on Fluency Builder, why don't we take a look at a couple of phrases.
segments.zh: 好吧，现在在流利表达上，我们为什么不看几个短语。

segments.en: Fluency Builder.
segments.zh: 流利表达。

segments.en: When the guy was kind of surprised, he said, wow, you really went all out.
segments.zh: 当这家伙有点惊讶时，他说，哇，你真的全力以赴。

segments.en: Okay, so this comes from the phrase, to go all out.
segments.zh: 好吧，这来自短语，全力以赴。

segments.en: So he went all out or I'm going to go all out.
segments.zh: 所以他全力以赴，或者说我要全力以赴。

segments.en: And this means to give something your best, to do more than is expected.
segments.zh: 这意味着尽你所能，做的事情超出预期。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So if you go all out when you're making breakfast, it means you just, you cooked a lot or really good and you spend a lot of time doing it.
segments.zh: 所以如果你在做早餐时全力以赴，意思就是你做了很多，或者做得特别好，花了很多时间在这上面。

segments.en: Or for example, if it's someone's birthday and I know it's their birthday, I go all out by buying gifts and a cake and lots of decorations and calling all of their friends and having a party.
segments.zh: 或者，例如，如果是某人的生日，我知道这是他们的生日，我会全力以赴购买礼物、蛋糕和大量装饰品，并打电话给他们所有的朋友并举办派对。

segments.en: So this is doing everything for them.
segments.zh: 所以这为他们做一切。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: And he was really surprised and he really seemed to enjoy breakfast and he said, looks good.
segments.zh: 他真的很惊讶，他似乎真的很喜欢早餐，他说，看起来不错。

segments.en: Okay, this is a way to say good job or nicely done.
segments.zh: 好的，这是一种说好工作或做得很好的方式。

segments.en: It's almost a way to say, I'm happy about this.
segments.zh: 这几乎是一种说法，我对此感到高兴。

segments.en: Or yeah, and obviously you can also say that the food looks delicious, so it looks good.
segments.zh: 或者是的，显然你也可以说食物看起来很好吃，所以看起来不错。

segments.en: It looks good.
segments.zh: 看起来不错。

segments.en: So it's a way to say, you know, well done, looks good or in this case, looks very tasty.
segments.zh: 所以这是一种说，你知道，做得好，看起来不错，或者在这种情况下，看起来很美味。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: And now this is an interesting part.
segments.zh: 现在这是一个有趣的部分。

segments.en: He says, I'll squeeze us some fresh orange juice.
segments.zh: 他说，我给我们挤一些新鲜的橙汁。

segments.en: So let's take a look at this verb, squeeze.
segments.zh: 所以让我们看一下这个动词，挤压。

segments.en: To squeeze.
segments.zh: 挤压。

segments.en: This is something you usually do with your hand when you tighten something.
segments.zh: 这是你在收紧某物时通常用手做的事情。

segments.en: So for example, your toothpaste.
segments.zh: 例如，你的牙膏。

segments.en: Yes, you squeeze your toothpaste so the toothpaste will come out.
segments.zh: 是的，你挤压你的牙膏，这样牙膏就会出来。

segments.en: So in this case, we are squeezing the orange juice to extract the juice.
segments.zh: 所以在这种情况下，我们挤压橙汁来提取果汁。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So you, you hold the orange very tight, you make the juice come out and then you have fresh squeezed orange juice.
segments.zh: 所以你把橙子紧紧握住，把果汁挤出来，然后就得到了鲜榨橙汁。

segments.en: And this is different from orange juice you buy in a store.
segments.zh: 这与您在商店购买的橙汁不同。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So you can say, I'll squeeze us some fresh orange juice.
segments.zh: 所以你可以说，我会给我们挤一些新鲜的橙汁。

segments.en: That means you're going to make fresh orange juice.
segments.zh: 这意味着你要做新鲜的橙汁。

segments.en: And this fresh orange juice that you make is called fresh squeezed orange juice.
segments.zh: 你制作的这种新鲜的橙汁被称为鲜榨橙汁。

segments.en: Fresh squeezed.
segments.zh: 鲜榨。

segments.en: You've probably seen this in the store, like some bottles, they say a hundred percent fresh squeezed orange juice or something.
segments.zh: 你可能在商店里看到过这个，就像一些瓶子一样，他们说百分百新鲜的鲜榨橙汁什么的。

segments.en: Yeah, it's good for advertising.
segments.zh: 是的，这对广告有好处。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So very good.
segments.zh: 非常好。

segments.en: A lot of great, interesting phrases there.
segments.zh: 那里有很多很棒的、有趣的短语。

segments.en: Why don't we listen to our dialogue one last time?
segments.zh: 我们最后再听一遍对话怎么样？

segments.en: Smells good.
segments.zh: 闻起来真香。

segments.en: What's for breakfast?
segments.zh: 早餐吃什么？

segments.en: Well, since we're getting up so late, I decided to make a big breakfast.
segments.zh: 好吧，既然我们起得这么晚，我决定做一顿丰盛的早餐。

segments.en: Nice brunch.
segments.zh: 不错的早午餐。

segments.en: Kind of.
segments.zh: 有点儿。

segments.en: So I made scrambled and soft boiled eggs, some French toast and buttermilk pancakes.
segments.zh: 我做了炒蛋、溏心煮蛋、法式吐司，还有酪乳煎饼。

segments.en: Wow.
segments.zh: 哇。

segments.en: You really went all out.
segments.zh: 你真的全力以赴。

segments.en: Did you make any coffee?
segments.zh: 你煮咖啡了吗？

segments.en: Yeah, just the way you like it.
segments.zh: 是的，就是你喜欢的方式。

segments.en: I also put out some cereal and muesli if you feel like having something more light.
segments.zh: 如果想吃得清淡点，我还准备了早餐谷物和混合果仁燕麦片。

segments.en: Looks good.
segments.zh: 看起来不错。

segments.en: I'll squeeze us some fresh orange juice.
segments.zh: 我会给我们挤一些新鲜的橙汁。

segments.en: Get the jam and butter while you are in there.
segments.zh: 你去那边时，顺便把果酱和黄油拿过来。

segments.en: Oh, and don't forget the syrup.
segments.zh: 哦，别忘了糖浆。

segments.en: All righty.
segments.zh: 好嘞。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So talking about brunch and breakfast, what is your typical or ideal breakfast?
segments.zh: 说到早午餐和早餐，你的典型或理想早餐是什么？

segments.en: That's a hard question.
segments.zh: 这是一个很难的问题。

segments.en: Breakfast is my favorite meal of the day.
segments.zh: 早餐是我一天中最喜欢的一餐。

segments.en: So I could eat breakfast, all kinds of breakfast anytime.
segments.zh: 所以我可以随时吃早餐，各种早餐。

segments.en: But one of my favorite kinds of breakfast is a Greek diner breakfast.
segments.zh: 但我最喜欢的早餐之一是希腊小餐馆式早餐。

segments.en: Greek diner.
segments.zh: 希腊餐厅。

segments.en: What does this have?
segments.zh: 这都包括什么？

segments.en: Well, we have a lot of diners or small restaurants that are very, very cheap and fast in America.
segments.zh: 好吧，在美国我们有很多小餐馆，价钱很便宜，上菜也很快。

segments.en: And this usually involves some scrambled eggs that are made with cheese and toast and potatoes and bacon and sausage and a coffee.
segments.zh: 这通常包括加了奶酪的炒蛋，配上吐司、土豆、培根、香肠和一杯咖啡。

segments.en: Wow.
segments.zh: 哇。

segments.en: Big breakfast.
segments.zh: 很丰盛的早餐。

segments.en: Very big.
segments.zh: 很大。

segments.en: But delicious.
segments.zh: 不过好吃。

segments.en: Nice.
segments.zh: 不错。

segments.en: What's your favorite?
segments.zh: 你最喜欢什么？

segments.en: I also really, really like breakfast.
segments.zh: 我也真的，真的很喜欢早餐。

segments.en: And I actually like having places that you can have 24-hour a day breakfast.
segments.zh: 我特别喜欢那种全天 24 小时都能吃到早餐的地方。

segments.en: All day breakfast is called.
segments.zh: 这叫全天早餐。

segments.en: So I can have breakfast for dinner.
segments.zh: 所以我可以吃早餐当晚餐。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: That's usually in America, you go to a diner because they have breakfast at four o'clock in the morning or at seven o'clock at night.
segments.zh: 在美国通常就是这样，你会去小餐馆，因为那里凌晨四点或晚上七点都能吃到早餐。

segments.en: I'm not really a coffee person.
segments.zh: 我不太爱喝咖啡。

segments.en: I actually enjoy either juice, orange juice, or hot chocolate.
segments.zh: 我实际上喜欢果汁、橙汁或热巧克力。

segments.en: I really like hot chocolate.
segments.zh: 我真的很喜欢热巧克力。

segments.en: And definitely pancakes.
segments.zh: 绝对是煎饼。

segments.en: Three buttermilk pancakes stacked.
segments.zh: 堆叠了三个酪乳煎饼。

segments.en: And as you said before, syrup.
segments.zh: 正如你之前所说，糖浆。

segments.en: But I actually also put butter on it.
segments.zh: 但我实际上也在上面放了黄油。

segments.en: Gross.
segments.zh: 恶心。

segments.en: I know a lot of people who do that.
segments.zh: 我认识很多这样做的人。

segments.en: They put butter on first and then they pour the syrup.
segments.zh: 他们先涂黄油，然后倒入糖浆。

segments.en: Yeah, of course.
segments.zh: 对，当然。

segments.en: So it's like complete, very, very fatty.
segments.zh: 所以就像一整套，非常非常油腻。

segments.en: And hash browns.
segments.zh: 和薯饼。

segments.en: I'm definitely a fan of hash browns.
segments.zh: 我绝对是薯饼的粉丝。

segments.en: Those are potatoes that are chopped very, very finely and you fry them together.
segments.zh: 那些是切碎的土豆，你把它们一起煎。

segments.en: So it almost becomes like a potato pancake.
segments.zh: 所以它几乎变成了一个土豆煎饼。

segments.en: Yeah, exactly.
segments.zh: 对，没错。

segments.en: So a lot of great stuff.
segments.zh: 所以很多很棒的东西。

segments.en: And obviously, breakfasts around the world are different.
segments.zh: 显然，世界各地的早餐是不同的。

segments.en: I know, for example, in some countries, they have the fisherman's breakfast.
segments.zh: 我知道，例如，在一些国家，他们有渔夫的早餐。

segments.en: So in the morning, you have black coffee, rice, and fish.
segments.zh: 所以在早上，你有黑咖啡、米饭和鱼。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Because you're going to work all day.
segments.zh: 因为你要整天上班。

segments.en: So we're really curious about how breakfast is in your country.
segments.zh: 所以我们真的很好奇你的国家的早餐怎么样。

segments.en: What a typical breakfast is like.
segments.zh: 典型的早餐是什么样的。

segments.zh: 是的，什么是传统早餐，你最喜欢的早餐是什么？

segments.zh: 再见。
